description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Overview

The Assistant Financial Controller supports Tavily's accounting, closing and financial reporting. Reporting to the Financial Controller, the role prepares accounting schedules, reconciles balances and helps maintain accurate, timely financial records.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal teams and external partners in a dynamic, cross-functional finance environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Participate in monthly, quarterly and annual closes, preparing journal entries and schedules.

- Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, including cash, receivables and payables; investigate discrepancies and follow up with bookkeeping providers and internal teams.

- Support revenue accounting for enterprise contracts, subscriptions, API credits and usage-based billing, including reconciliations of deferred and unbilled revenue.

- Review customer order forms for financial accuracy, billing schedules and payment terms; coordinate invoicing, billing queries and collections with Sales and Revenue Operations.

- Prepare intercompany reconciliations and assist with consolidation entries and financial reporting across the group.

- Assist with financial statements, management reports, cash reporting and analysis of significant changes in results and budget variances.

- Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for external audits and tax filings, working with the Controller and external advisers.

- Coordinate vendor and payment documentation, review expense coding, and resolve transaction discrepancies with relevant teams and providers.

- Maintain organized accounting records and help improve workflows, controls and automation; support finance projects as needed.

Key Qualifications and Experience

Must have qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, or Business Management.

- CPA qualification and a completed internship. Suitable for a first role after audit.

- Strong accounting fundamentals and experience preparing or auditing financial statements, reconciliations and supporting schedules.

- Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions and working with large datasets.

- Ability to analyze transactions, identify discrepancies and prepare clear, accurate documentation.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Ability to learn new systems, manage deadlines and collaborate with internal teams and external advisers.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with US GAAP, revenue recognition under ASC 606 and accounting for international entities.

- Exposure to accounting or billing systems such as QuickBooks, Stripe, Ramp or Tabs.

- Interest in improving finance processes through automation and AI tools.

Competencies and Working Style

- Organized and attentive to detail, with a consistent focus on accuracy.

- Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and follows issues through to resolution.

- Curious and analytical, with a willingness to understand the business behind the numbers.

- Works independently within agreed procedures and raises questions or exceptions promptly.

- Communicates clearly, prioritizes effectively and contributes practical ideas for improvement.

Benefits & Perks:

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.
title: Assistant Financial Controller

description:
As a SOC (Security Operations Center) Analyst, you will serve as the first line of defense against cybersecurity threats. You'll monitor security alerts, investigate potential incidents, and escalate confirmed security events. This role requires strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

What will your job look like:
- Continuously monitor security systems, networks, and endpoints using SIEM, and other InfoSec tools to detect anomalies and threats.

- Investigate and triage security alerts to validate threats and assess their impact and fine-tune existing alerts to minimize false positives and improve accuracy.

- Document and track security incidents according to established procedures.

- Escalate security incidents when appropriate.

- Maintain awareness of the current threat landscape.

- Follow incident response procedures and security playbooks.

- Generate reports on security events and metrics.

- Participate in rotational shifts to ensure 24/7 security monitoring coverage.

All you need is:
- Student with at least four semesters remaining.

- Ability to work weekends and nights.

- Ability to provide 4 shifts per week.

- Knowledge of basic security concepts, network protocols, and security tools.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documentation and reporting in English.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Nice to have:
- Previous work experience as a SOC analyst.

- Hands-on experience with SIEM/SOAR and EDR tools.

- Technological courses and certifications in the field of cyber security.

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!
title: SOC Analyst (Student position)

Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact

As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a vital role in our high-volume production process by operating, monitoring, and maintaining advanced equipment to ensure efficiency and quality standards are met. You'll have hands-on involvement in troubleshooting and optimizing tools, conducting quality checks, and ensuring the seamless assembly of products. Your efforts will directly contribute to producing top-tier products that drive Intel's success in the technology industry.

Business Group

Join Intel Corporation, a global leader in semiconductor innovation, where you will be part of a dynamic team dedicated to advancing manufacturing excellence. Our team collaborates to deliver high-quality products that empower progress and innovation worldwide. We operate in fast-paced environments, leveraging cutting-edge processes and technologies that support Intel's broader mission of shaping the future of computing and connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

- Operate, monitor, and maintain advanced manufacturing equipment to achieve output targets.

- Conduct online equipment adjustments and optimize processes to maintain production efficiency.

- Perform quality control evaluations on raw materials and finished products to ensure compliance with industry standards.

- Troubleshoot and resolve nonstandard events in the production line to ensure stable operations.

- Collaborate with the Manufacturing Operations Manager and team peers to meet production schedules and escalate risks when necessary.

- Support installation, qualification, and maintenance of new or reused production equipment.

- Maintain accurate production logs and required documentation per Standard Operating Procedures.

- Drive cost and quality improvements and assist in incorporating process enhancements.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

- Practical Engineer in a relevant technical field such as Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Hardware Engineering with hands-on experience gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.

- Proficiency in technical English to interpret manuals, document logs, and communicate effectively.

- Ability to work in a demanding 12-hour shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred Qualifications

- Relevant technical experience in a semiconductor cleanroom environment (FAB/SORT).

- Hands-on expertise in operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting manufacturing equipment.

- Familiarity with data-driven systems for tool monitoring and online adjustments.

Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the success of our manufacturing processes. We encourage you to bring your enthusiasm, technical skills, and dedication to this exciting opportunity to grow with Intel.

description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, designs and delivers custom silicon at the core of AWS (Amazon Web Services). Our devices define the cloud. From Trainium, the purpose-built machine learning accelerator powering the next wave of AI innovation, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that powers every AWS instance — Annapurna's products set the standard for the industry.

We are looking for software engineering student to join us in developing next-generation chips built on a new compute architecture. In this role, you will design and develop software for functional and performance validation.

Key job responsibilities

In this role you will join a team of experts developing system level software, targeting chip architecture, functional correctness and performance, running on various platforms and validating chip functionality.

Basic qualifications
Bachelor's degree Student Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines. Please include a grade sheet/academic transcript along with your CV in a single PDF when submitting your application in computer science or equivalent.

Experience programming with at least one software programming language.

Preferred qualifications
1+ year experience of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
